Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer was instructed to look up shipping rates for DHL after initial attempts with FedEx, without having successfully navigated or completed the rates search for USPS. This results in repeating incomplete tasks without resolving the initial requests. Moreover, the repeated attempts to interact with FedEx forms or pages without retrieving actionable data signals a loop or stagnation in the WebSurfer's progress, missing out on obtaining the USPS shipping rates first before moving to DHL.
